entityDescription:
Launched in January 2001, Infoterra GmbH is a 100% owned subsidiary of EADS Astrium, Europe's leading satellite company. Infoterra GmbH was specifically founded to prepare and conduct the commercial exploitation of TerraSAR-X.
Infoterra GmbH was formed by spinning-off the 'Earth Observation Services' division of the former Astrium GmbH, Germany, and is part of the European Infoterra Group together with Infoterra Ltd. (former National Remote Sensing Centre Ltd. NRSC) in the United Kingdom. Together with the French Spot Image S.A., the Infoterra Group forms EADS Astrium´s Earth Observation Services Group.
Today, Infoterra GmbH´s staff of 25 serves and supports both, public and private customers with geo-information on cartography, land use / land cover, and forestry as well as - with a focus on GMES (Global Monitoring for Environment and Security) and thematic mapping services. Following the multi mission concept and based on a wide network of scientists, service providers, and end-users, Infoterra GmbH continuously develops new and ambitious processing procedures as well as products with improved information content. 
Through creation of the InfoTerra/TerraSAR initiative in the late 90's, the Infoterra GmbH team has established the foundation for the market-derived business development approach for innovative commercial Earth observation. In 2004, Infoterra GmbH has started marketing the exclusive commercial exploitation of TerraSAR-X. 
Infoterra GmbH supports the European GMES programme, which was initiated jointly by the European Space Agency (ESA) and the European Commission (EC). Infoterra understands this initiative as a major opportunity to provide operational geo-information services for the benefit of the environment and security.
Infoterra is ISO9001:2000 and ISO 14001 certified and guarantees that all work is completed according to internationally accepted quality and environmental standards.
Infoterra GmbH is a founding member of GEOkomm, a federation of the geo-information industry in Berlin/Brandenburg and is also represented in the German Association of Geo-Information Industries (Deutscher Dachverband der Geoinformationswirtschaft 'DDGI'). Using these platforms, Infoterra GmbH is able to support the definition of industrial standards.

entityDescription:
HISDESAT Servicios Estratégicos SA se fundó en 2001 como operador gubernamental de servicios satelitales, principalmente en los ámbitos de defensa, seguridad, inteligencia y asuntos exteriores. Desde 2005, la compañía proporciona comunicaciones satelitales seguras a organismos gubernamentales de diversos países. Este sistema de comunicaciones gubernamentales se basa en dos satélites geoestacionarios en operación (SpainSat, lanzado en 2006, y Xtar-Eur, lanzado en 2005) que ofrecen cobertura de comunicaciones en dos tercios de la Tierra. En 2019, Hisdesat inició el proceso de adquisición de la próxima generación de satélites (SPAINSAT-NG) mediante un contrato con el Ministerio de Defensa español.

Desde 2018, Hisdesat también ofrece servicios de observación de la Tierra a través de su satélite PAZ. PAZ utiliza un radar de apertura sintética (SAR) para capturar imágenes de la Tierra con fines gubernamentales y comerciales, además de otros sensores meteorológicos y de seguimiento de buques, lo que permite la cartografía de alta resolución de grandes áreas geográficas tanto de día como de noche. Estas imágenes de alta resolución se utilizan para operaciones militares, control fronterizo, inteligencia, monitoreo ambiental, protección de recursos naturales, planificación urbana y de infraestructuras, y seguimiento de catástrofes naturales. El satélite Paz opera en una constelación con los satélites SAR alemanes TerraSAR-X y TanDEM-X en la misma órbita.
Finalmente, HISDESAT ha participado en la creación de una constelación de satélites para información de tráfico marítimo (AIS).

entityDescription:
G.L. Electronic (SME) is a privately held Czech company operating in the space industry since 2008. We draw on professional experience gained in foreign companies engaged mainly in a production and an application for the space and ground technologies. G.L. Electronic has more than 13 years of experience with realization of assembly activities and providing technical support for the design of flight devices in many various international space projects, both with Czech and foreign partners. Company is focused on production of Hi-Rel electronic instruments and harnesses for aerospace technologies: procurement, design, assembly, integration and testing of cable harnesses and rework, modification, complete implementation of bonding and conformal coating on the PCBs (level EM, EQM, FM). The company performs the complete output quality control of these production processes as well. 
Testing: Electrical testing of cable harnesses (continuity test, isolation test and double-wire measuring), wire tension test, testing in the vacuum and climate chamber, endoscopic visual inspection, portable 3-channel laser meter of dust particles and microsectionning.
The implementation of the above mentioned activities is performed in clean room ISO8 (class 100 000) or in a laboratory - both with the continuous measurement of temperature and humidity. 
The team of the company consists of professionally ESA trained and certified technicians. The certification is according to the ESA-ECSS-Q-70 standards issued by the company Instituto Italiáno della Saldatura in Genova that is authorized to award the ESA certification. The company G.L.Electronic operates especially in the EU countries. 
G.L.Electronic uses the previous professional experience even in the field of industrial electronics focused on the production and nonstandard production applications.

entityDescription: At Specto Natura, our expertise allows us to provide input into improved understanding and management of the linkages between the natural dynamics and the complex human use of landscape through the application of Earth Observation. The expertise within Specto Natura extends from the fundamental physical basis of the measurements being made and the processes they illuminate to the practical application of such information and the socio-economic and conservation impact. Specto Natura is heavily involved in the European Commission Global Monitoring for Environment and Security (GMES) initiative focusing on the development of sustainable services in the Land domain.
